Subject: Your tenancy eviction matter - R.C.S. No. 632/2021

Dear Mr. Khan,

Thank you for meeting us on 28 February 2022 about your dispute with Thomas Sen. As we understand it, the tenant has sublet the flat without permission.

Our advice is to collect evidence of unauthorised subletting such as utility bills in the occupant's name. Please collect utility bills in the occupant's name and statements of the neighbours and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Mrinalini Saraf
